title: Majority maximizes singleton coefficient sum
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$. The sum of the singleton Fourier coefficients of $f$ is at most the sum of the singleton Fourier coefficients of majority, where majority is $+1$ when the coordinate sum is nonnegative and $-1$ otherwise.
